TyrandeRanger.name: Ranger
TyrandeRanger.description: Sentinel pierces the first Hero hit. Its width is increased by 25% and deals up to 250% more damage based on distance traveled.

TyrandeMasteryLunarBlaze.name: Lunar Blaze
TyrandeMasteryLunarBlaze.description: Increase Lunar Flare's range by 30%. Quest: Hitting a Hero with Lunar Flare increases its damage by 5%, up to 150%.

TyrandeTrueshotAura.name: Trueshot Aura
TyrandeTrueshotAura.description: Activate to grant other nearby allied Heroes 40% increased Attack Damage for 5 seconds, and to reset the cooldown of Hunter's Mark. Passive: Basic Attack damage increased by 30%.

TyrandeLightOfEluneEverlastingLight.name: Everlasting Light
TyrandeLightOfEluneEverlastingLight.description: If Light of Elune's second charge is cast on a different target from the first, it heals for 80% more.

TyrandeMarkofMending.name: Mark of Mending
TyrandeMarkofMending.description: Tyrande's Basic Attacks against Marked targets heal other allied Heroes near the enemy for 4% of their maximum Health.

TyrandeElunesChosen.name: Elune's Chosen
TyrandeElunesChosen.description: Activate to make Tyrande's Basic Attacks heal target allied Hero for 175% of the damage dealt. Lasts for 8 seconds.

TyrandeMoonlitArrows.name: Moonlit Arrows
TyrandeMoonlitArrows.description: Basic Attacks decrease the cooldown of Light of Elune by an additional 0.75 seconds.

TyrandeKaldoreiResistance.name: Kaldorei Resistance
TyrandeKaldoreiResistance.description: Light of Elune grants the target 10 Spell Armor for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 2 times.

TyrandeHuntressFury.name: Huntress' Fury
TyrandeHuntressFury.description: Increase the cast range and duration of Hunter's Mark by 25%. Tyrande's Basic Attacks against targets with Hunter's Mark bounce to nearby enemy Heroes.

TyrandeHeroicAbilityShadowstalk.name: Shadowstalk
TyrandeHeroicAbilityShadowstalk.description: Grant all allied Heroes Stealth for 10 seconds and heal them for 380 (+4% per level) Health over 10 seconds. Remaining stationary for at least 1.5 seconds while Stealthed grants Invisible.

TyrandeHeroicAbilityStarfall.name: Starfall
TyrandeHeroicAbilityStarfall.description: Deal 92 (+4% per level) damage per second and Slow enemies by 20% in an area. Lasts 6 seconds.

TyrandeMasteryLightofEluneQuickeningBles.name: Quickening Blessing
TyrandeMasteryLightofEluneQuickeningBles.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Light of Elune increases the target's Movement Speed by 20% for 3 seconds.

TyrandeHarshMoonlight.name: Harsh Moonlight
TyrandeHarshMoonlight.description: Sentinel Slows enemies hit by 35% and reduces their damage dealt by 35% for 3 seconds.

TyrandeRangersMark.name: Ranger's Mark
TyrandeRangersMark.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Hunter's Mark by 2 second. Basic Attacks against marked targets reduce the cooldown of Lunar Flare by 4 seconds.

TyrandeCelestialAttunement.name: Celestial Attunement
TyrandeCelestialAttunement.description: Light of Elune removes Stuns, Silences, and Slows from its target.

TyrandeEmpower.name: Empower
TyrandeEmpower.description: Reduce Sentinel's cooldown by 3 seconds. Heroes hit by Sentinel takes bonus damage equal to 6% of their maximum Health.

TyrandeDarnassianArchery.name: Darnassian Archery
TyrandeDarnassianArchery.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes grant a stacking 12% increased Attack Damage bonus for 4 seconds.

TyrandeEyesOfTheHuntress.name: Eyes of the Huntress
TyrandeEyesOfTheHuntress.description: Shadowstalk reveals all enemy Heroes for 10 seconds and heals for 75% more.

TyrandeMasteryStarfallCelestialWrath.name: Celestial Wrath
TyrandeMasteryStarfallCelestialWrath.description: Increase the Slow of Starfall to 60% and cause it to apply Hunter's Mark to enemy Heroes while inside of its area of effect.

TyrandeShootingStar.name: Shooting Star
TyrandeShootingStar.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1. Every 8th Basic Attack casts a free Lunar Flare at a random enemy near Tyrande's position. This prefers Heroic targets.

TyrandeIcebladeArrows.name: Iceblade Arrows
TyrandeIcebladeArrows.description: Increase Attack Speed by 20%. Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes reduce their damage dealt by 8% for 2 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times.
